item.question: Why are cumulative distribution functions (CDF) important for understanding Doppler effects?
item.answer: Cumulative distribution functions (CDF) are important because they provide insights into the probability that observed Doppler frequencies fall below certain values. This helps characterize and predict signal behavior under various environmental conditions and motion scenarios.
